scope: Original base game standard core + applicable linked Living FAQ; optional modules excluded

questions.question: A Power such as Words of Warning makes Dahan deal Ravage Damage earlier than normal. Is that an extra attack in addition to the normal counterattack?
For outcome checks, how are a Fear Card containing only each-player instructions and one containing a global instruction plus each-player instructions divided into actions?

An Invader is left illegally in an Ocean after its primary action and all triggered actions finish. Assume it was not Drowned. May it remain there, where is it placed instead, and does that relocation count as movement or trigger movement effects?

A Ravage adds Blight that reduces Vital Strength of the Earth’s Sacred Site to one Presence. Does losing the site retroactively remove its Defend from the Damage simultaneously dealt to Dahan in that Ravage?

Can a Spirit give its unused Energy or Card Plays to another Spirit, or save unused Card Plays for the next turn? How does this differ from an explicit Power that grants another Spirit Energy or an extra play?
What is the order of the Invader Phase, and if a Blighted Island start-of-phase effect destroys a Spirit’s last Presence, may an earned Fear Card resolve first to avert defeat?
Bringer uses a Power whose explicit instructions include Damage or Destroy Dahan, followed by other legal effects. Are the Dahan harmed, and must the entire Power be skipped?
Does Shadows of the Dahan's Range-ignoring targeting ability extend a numeric Range arrow within a Power's effect text? How does a general Power Range boost differ?

A Power's own threshold gives it +1 Range. If the threshold is met on both the original use and its Repeat, does the Repeat get +2 Range? If that threshold is no longer met on the Repeat, is the first +1 retained?

A Spirit plays two Power Cards and later Repeats one. For an effect counting Power Cards played, such as Boon of Vigor, is the count two or three? Does the Repeat consume another ordinary Card Play, and does it nevertheless count as a new Power use?

A Blighted Island instruction simply tells each Spirit to destroy one of its Presence. May a Spirit choose a disk still covering its Presence track to uncover a benefit instead of destroying island Presence, and where does a destroyed disk go?
In standard setup using a Blight Card, how is the card chosen, which side starts face-up, and may players inspect its reverse before choosing or starting?

A Spirit has met an unused Innate’s Element requirements but has no cards in hand, no Energy and no ordinary Card Plays left. Can it use that Innate at the proper speed, what Energy or Card Play cost does it ordinarily have, and is it automatically available every turn?

Without an effect granting a Repeat or another use, may a Spirit pay a Power Card's printed Energy cost twice to use it twice in one turn? If a Slow Power is made Fast, may it be used once in Fast and again in Slow?

For a standard game, how many balanced Island Boards are used and chosen, how are their initial Invaders, Dahan and Blight placed, and how are the Minor/Major decks and shared piece supplies prepared?

Ocean In Play is active on a board. Infinite Vitality with its threshold protects Dahan in that Ocean, and a Power Pushes a Dahan into it. Ocean In Play triggers but cannot destroy that Dahan. With an adjacent non-Ocean land available, what happens next: does the Dahan remain until cleanup, or is it Pushed? Is that relocation an actual Push within the triggered action or merely cleanup?

A land-targeting Power Card is Repeated using a permission that does not specify where the Repeat occurs. Must it use the original target land? May it instead use another legal land, and do the ordinary Range and Target restrictions still apply?

Concealing Shadows has already resolved in Fast, so Dahan in its target land take no Damage from Ravaging Invaders this turn. That land now Ravages with one Town, one Explorer and two healthy Dahan, no Defend and no prior Blight. What happens to land and Dahan, how much counterattack Damage is available, and can it destroy both Invaders for how much Ravage-generated Fear?

An effect explicitly adds two Blight simultaneously to one land containing two Presence from each of two Spirits. Counting only Presence destroyed in that land by this one addition, how many disks does each Spirit lose? Would adding one Blight there in each of two separate completed instructions destroy Presence once or twice, assuming each Spirit still has Presence there?
